title: Sleep, Recovery, and Healthspan
lessons: The player considers WHOOP because the product frames sleep and recovery as core performance inputs, not just workout statistics.
The player already uses WHOOP and sees Healthspan turn long-term habits into a Pace of Aging estimate.

text: The player considers WHOOP because the product frames sleep and recovery as core performance inputs, not just workout statistics.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I came here because I am tired.

entry-first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. That is more interesting than steps.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: To you, maybe.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHOOP
text: Sleep, Recovery, Strain. I connect tonight to what you ask of yourself tomorrow instead of pretending performance starts at the gym door.

choice-first.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: That is more useful to me than counting steps.
I worry I would start obsessing over sleep scores.
I do not want to wear a tracker to bed.

first-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then you understand my pitch better than half the gym.

first-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: That can happen. A sleep score is supposed to explain a pattern, not become bedtime homework.

first-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then I lose the most important part of the dataset for you.
The player already uses WHOOP and sees Healthspan turn long-term habits into a Pace of Aging estimate.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You turned aging into a number.

entry-return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: I turned your reaction to that sentence into a number too. Kidding.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You are not funny enough to joke about that.

entry-return-4.speaker: WHOOP
text: Healthspan looks at longer-term habits and gives a Pace of Aging estimate. It is a model, not a prophecy.

choice-return.speaker: WHOOP
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like seeing whether my habits add up over time.
That is a very powerful number to put in front of someone.
I do not want an app telling me how fast I am aging.

return-1.speaker: WHOOP
text: Long-term pattern is exactly why I measure every boring day.

return-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: Good. An estimate should survive skepticism.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You are enjoying this.

return-2-2.speaker: WHOOP
text: A little.

return-3.speaker: WHOOP
text: Then turn away from this feature. More information is not automatically better information for you.
